source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Mathematics question. Chapter: math/grade_06/ch_03. The student must decide: Decide what a spoken or written number is reporting from the rule of the situation. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. Every option must be a claim that could answer the stem, and wrong options must be the same kind of answer as the key (a next term, a named process, or a row of the same shape). If the stem continues a number list, every option names a next term. Never write that naming or writing a term is what creates the list.
